$comment: Copy of pdfnative docs/data/errors.json -> buildErrors with the ${placeholders} substituted by sample values. pdfnative does not ship docs/ in its npm tarball, so this fixture is refreshed by hand at every engine bump (see tests/fixtures/README.md); tests/utils/build-errors.test.ts asserts every builder message classifies as E_INPUT (the two non-builder entries — the annotation-type check and PdfStreamLimitError — are classified elsewhere).

messages.message: layout.pdfx: unknown target 'pdfx1a' — use one of pdfx4
layout.pdfx cannot be combined with tagged: 'pdfa1b' — PDF/A-1 is PDF 1.4 and PDF/X-4 is PDF 1.6; claim 'pdfa2b' or 'pdfa2u' alongside PDF/X-4
layout.pdfx cannot be combined with tagged: 'pdfa3b' — PDF/A-3 allows embedded files, which PDF/X-4 forbids; claim 'pdfa2b' or 'pdfa2u' alongside PDF/X-4
Spot colour 'PANTONE 300 C' is not declared — add { name: 'PANTONE 300 C', alternate: [c, m, y, k] } to layout.print.spotColours
Ink mix PANTONE 300 C + Spot Varnish: every ink of a mix needs the same alternate space (all CMYK or all RGB)
print.spotColours: every ink needs a non-empty name
print.spotColours: 'Varnish' has a CMYK alternate out of range — percentages 0–100
print.spotColours: 'Varnish' has an RGB alternate out of range — 0–255
print.spotColours: 'Varnish' needs an alternate of four CMYK percentages or three RGB values
print.spotColours: ink 'Varnish' is declared twice
PDF/X forbids encryption (ISO 15930-7) — drop layout.encryption or layout.pdfx
PDF/X-4 requires layout.outputIntent: the ICC profile of the printing condition, e.g. ISO Coated v2 or GRACoL from your printer. pdfnative ships no press profile
PDF/X-4 requires an output (printer) profile as layout.outputIntent — the supplied profile's class is 'mntr'
PDF/X requires the trapping state to be known — set metadata.trapped to 'True' or 'False', or omit it for 'False'
PDF/X pages carry a TrimBox or an ArtBox, not both — drop print.artBox, or print.trimBox and print.bleed
outputIntent.iccProfile is too short to be an ICC profile (128-byte header required)
outputIntent.iccProfile is not an ICC profile (no `acsp` signature at byte 36)
outputIntent.iccProfile header declares 9968 bytes but 4096 were supplied — the profile is truncated or corrupt
outputIntent.iccProfile declares data colour space 'Lab' — an OutputIntent profile must describe RGB, CMYK or Gray
print.marks requires a TrimBox — set print.bleed or print.trimBox
print.bleed and print.trimBox are mutually exclusive — the shorthand derives the TrimBox
PDF/A and encryption are mutually exclusive (ISO 19005-1 §6.3.2)
File attachments require tagged: 'pdfa3b' (PDF/A-3, ISO 19005-3)
print.bleed must be a positive number of points
print.bleed leaves no trim area — it must be less than half the smaller page dimension
print.trimBox must be [x0, y0, x1, y1] with x1 > x0 and y1 > y0
print.trimBox must lie within the MediaBox [0 0 595.28 841.89]
print.trimBox must lie within the BleedBox
print.userUnit must be between 1 and 75000
Watermark transparency is not allowed with PDF/A-1b (ISO 19005-1 §6.4)
print.userUnit requires PDF 1.6+ and is not allowed under PDF/A-1 (PDF 1.4) — use pdfa2b or later
Unknown annotation type "stamp" — expected one of: highlight, underline, strikeout, squiggly, square, circle, line, text, link

messages.thrownBy: inflateSync / applyDecodeFilter, rethrown by extractText (onStreamError: 'limit' default), openPdf().decodeStream, validatePdfX, validatePdfUA (class PdfStreamLimitError, code PDF_STREAM_LIMIT)
messages.message: FlateDecode output exceeds the 104857600-byte limit (potential zip bomb) — raise setMaxInflateOutputSize() or pass onStreamError: 'skip'
